gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Eater looks dark and bitten, with gaps between its letters. Noto Sans Ethiopic sits beneath it with sturdy, tall lowercase, so give that body text the larger size and leave the heading alone.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Eater is all menace, thin strokes beside heavier stems. Noto Sans Grantha does the opposite job, offering tall, flattened little letters whose bowls never close up, so reading keeps moving.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Dark, jagged and a bit threatening. Noto Sans Hebrew takes over from Eater's menace with a dominant midsection and wide gaps where curves meet stems, so lines stay easy to follow.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads friendly, with wide open counters and outward curves. Audiowide's tile-like, uniform-stroke letters feel futuristic above it, while the body text moves along smoothly beneath.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. And Noto Sans Telugu follows with a high midline and open counters, so the text flows along without any snagging.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Futuristic and tile-like, with wide gaps. Audiowide keeps its stroke ends as wide as the middle, while Noto Sans Thai Looped brings tall, bold-looking lowercase and spacious curve terminals underneath.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-vithku: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. Noto Sans Vithkuqi handles the plain work, with open throats on a, c, e and s and barely any step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Audiowide lays out futuristic, tile-like glyphs with wide gaps and no stroke contrast at all. Noto Sans Wancho counters with a hulking, chalky lowercase.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-warang: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never pinches its letters shut. Shrink that heading and the detail fades, while Noto Sans Warang Citi blows up well, with words that read as solid blocks.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-mono: Dark, spiky and a little feral. Eater leads with restrained thick-thin rhythm, while Noto Sans Mono keeps generously spaced, tall lowercase that makes every word look sturdy and large.
